{{Quote|On behalf of the Nine Ruling Families of the Chiss Ascendancy, I welcome you all to this solemn and sorrowful occasion. We stand today on the deck of an ancient vessel that lies here as a symbol of human courage and Chiss failing &hellip;|Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="SQ" />}}
In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> a '''ceremony''' was held to atone for the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] involvement in the [[Battle for Outbound Flight|destruction]] of the ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. The ceremony was overseen by [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Formbi," of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] and attended by representatives of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] including Formbi's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] and second niece [[Chaf'ees'aklaio]], core name "Feesa," and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Prard'ras'kleoni]], core name "Drask," of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]]. Members of the [[New Jedi Order]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], also attended.<ref name="SQ" />
